content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate Degree in Physics/Electronics/Materials Science/Chemistry Related Subject and qualified CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant professorship) and GATE or selection process through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NITs etc.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at National Institute of Technology Raipur. This recruitment offers a single position for eligible candidates in a specialized research field.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIT Raipur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Raipur is 31 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their email application, including all required documents, reaches the institute before this deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position should not be more than 28 years of age. Age relaxation will be provided as per the existing Government of India norms for eligible categories, ensuring fair opportunity.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at NIT Raipur will receive a monthly salary of Rs 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA). This remuneration package is competitive and aligned with research fellowship standards.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for NIT Raipur JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Physics, Electronics, Materials Science, or a Chemistry Related Subject. Additionally, they must have qualified CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or an equivalent national-level examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for NIT Raipur JRF vacancies?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancies at NIT Raipur is via email. Interested candidates need to prepare their complete application and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIT Raipur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempt from paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JRF post at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Raipur involves an interview. This interview can be conducted either offline or online, as decided by the recruitment committee, to assess candidate suitability.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview date for the NIT Raipur JRF position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Raipur is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates who are shortlisted based on their applications will be called for this interview process.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010. It is a prominent government institution offering various academic and research opportunities in the region.
